how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-timbermaw-hold-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6031:obj:0: Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
rows.quest:6031:details:0: In Timbermaw, we are content. We do not like strangers. This is good for us, but it is bad for trade.
rows.quest:6031:details:1: BNot long ago, a rare night elf friend came to Timbermaw and she wore a runecloth cloak. Runecloth is rare among us, but the cloak was so fine my people want me to make more runecloth clothing.
rows.quest:6031:details:2: BWill you bring me runecloth? If you bring me enough, then I will give you something in trade.
rows.quest:6031:completion:0: Ah, you brought the cloth. Such fine material it is!
rows.quest:6031:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦1⟧. You are a true friend. Please accept this in exchange.
rows.quest:6032:obj:0: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
rows.quest:6032:details:0: Although the people of Timbermaw delight in the feel of runecloth, it is not sacred to us. But mooncloth is sacred.
rows.quest:6032:details:1: BBring me a small supply of this holy cloth, and I will teach you a secret fashioning technique.
rows.quest:6032:completion:0: Ah, very good. This mooncloth will be used for garments sacred to our people. Thank you, ⟦2⟧. Now I will train you.
rows.quest:8461:obj:0: Nafien would like you to kill 6 ⟦E1⟧ Den Watchers, 6 ⟦E1⟧ Avengers, and 6 ⟦E1⟧ Shamans. Return to him in northern ⟦E2⟧ near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
rows.quest:8461:details:0: There is a camp of ⟦E1⟧ furbolgs directly to our southwest. ⟦E3⟧ permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem.
rows.quest:8461:details:1: BThe ⟦E1⟧ tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds. Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped. It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren.
rows.quest:8461:details:2: BPlease, ⟦3⟧ - I ask you to do what must be done. Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.
rows.quest:8461:completion:0: I sense that you have achieved victory. Victory... such a hollow word considering what had to be done. Regardless, you've proven yourself to be worthy of our trust.
rows.quest:8461:completion:1: BIt may take some time before the Timbermaw welcome you without hostility within the Hold. Still, your perseverance will erode any suspicion my brethren may have about you. So long as you never betray us and raise weapons against us, we will find common ground.
rows.quest:8464:obj:0: Salfa wants you to kill 8 Winterfall ⟦E4⟧, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Ursa. Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:8464:details:0: The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves, ⟦4⟧. While we do allow safe passage to those we trust, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible.
rows.quest:8464:details:1: BThe Winterfall tribe as of late has become increasingly hostile towards us. They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand.
rows.quest:8464:details:2: BI must ask you to thin their numbers as to lessen the threat against us. Seek them out in Winterfall Village, far to the east of here.
rows.quest:8464:completion:0: Thank you for what you have done, as saddening as it is. Accept this as a token of thanks.
rows.quest:8464:completion:1: BI would ask of you to please continue helping us, ⟦5⟧. We have very few allies on which to call upon, and without your aid, the threats against my tribe would surely be too much for us to handle alone.
rows.quest:8481:obj:0: Plant the Demon Summoning Torch in the mouth of High Chief Winterfall's cave in the Winterfall furbolg village. Defeat the demon and retrieve the Essence of Xandivious for Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.
rows.quest:8481:details:0: ⟦6⟧, thanks to you we have devised a way to summon forth the root of all evil for the Winterfall tribe - the corrupting demon that dominates them!
rows.quest:8481:details:1: BTake this torch to the mouth of High Chief Winterfall's personal cave and plant it there. Doing so will force the demon to reveal itself and investigate. This is when you and your allies must strike it down! Only the essence of the fallen demon will begin the lengthy healing process of the Winterfall tribe... and the ⟦E6⟧ of Timbermaw Hold.
rows.quest:8481:completion:0: You've... you've saved us! Your defeat of the demon Xandivious has ensured the safety of Timbermaw Hold for years to come. You are truly a hero amongst our kind.
rows.quest:8481:completion:1: BPlease, accept this with our blessing. Though the healing process will be slow amongst the furbolgs - and the conflict will still go on - you have given the Winterfall something they never had before this day.
rows.quest:8481:completion:2: BThey have a chance at survival.
rows.quest:8484:obj:0: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to King Magni Bronzebeard in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:8484:details:0: Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, ⟦7⟧. If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with.
rows.quest:8484:details:1: BPlease - take this offering to the dwarven king that resides in a mountain of iron; I believe you call this city ⟦E7⟧. In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his ⟦E8⟧. It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your ⟦E8⟧'s efforts in brokering peace.
rows.quest:8484:completion:0: Indeed, this is a most fortuitous turn of events. Were a lasting peace to be made with these creatures, this would certainly give us an advantage in the affairs of ⟦E9⟧... one that the Night Elves cannot support on their own. I will notify the other leaders of the ⟦E8⟧ of this immediately, and further diplomats will be dispatched!
rows.quest:8484:completion:1: BAs for you, ⟦8⟧... you have shown courage in both diplomacy and in action. I thank you, as does the whole of the ⟦E8⟧.

rows.quest:8485:details:1: BPlease - take this offering to the orcish warchief that resides in the lands of ⟦E11⟧; I believe you call this city ⟦E10⟧. In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his ⟦E12⟧. It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your ⟦E12⟧'s efforts in brokering peace.
rows.quest:8485:completion:0: Indeed, this is a most fortuitous turn of events. Were a lasting peace to be made with these creatures, this would certainly give us an advantage in securing ⟦E9⟧ from external threats. I will notify the other leaders of the ⟦E12⟧ of this immediately, and further diplomats will be dispatched!
